title: Definitely not non-stick
text:
Definitely not non-stick. I just cooked my first meal in this wok - a frozen chicken parm meal I usually cook in a skillet. After pouring the cooked contents into a bowl, I ran the wok under the kitchen sink to rinse out the remaining sauce. I was surprised to see a small amount of cheese and sauce still in the pan. I drizzled some detergent into the pan and brushed it vigorously for about 15 seconds with a scrub brush. There was still some cheese stuck to the wok. I scrubbed it again - bowl and rim. This time the bowl was clean but the rim still had cheese stuck to it at the point I had poured it into the bowl.

This wok was a replacement for a larger 13" one that had a toxic non-stick coating. Though smaller, the new wok was much heavier. It was slightly uncomfortable to hold while pouring the meal into a bowl.

The wok came in pieces but was easy to assemble with the included wrench. The wok also included a rubber spatula, which was nice. The lid does not fit as snugly as my old wok's lid did. Don't know if this will be a problem yet.

Bottom line - it's a nice looking wok, that's pretty heavy, almost too heavy and the description should definitely be stick-resistant, not non-stick.

UPDATE:
The more I use this wok, the less I like it. I have to soak it after each use because food always sticks to it - even if it is coated with cooking oil. The surface texture is a gimmick. It performs no function that I can detect. After running the lid though the dishwasher, it collects moisture under the handle - yes, I made sure it was screwed on tight. The weight is ridiculous. I can't hold it one handed for more than 10 seconds. Demoted to 2 stars.
